move.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Dear Ms Procházková,

Thank you for your quotation and for the warm words. We value your interest in a long-term partnership and would like to build on it.

Our data shows a different picture from the offer:

Your on-time delivery was 62.5% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70240@2026Q3).

German labour costs in manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).

With this in mind, we have put together options that give you planning security and a clear basis for the cooperation. Each one can be taken forward as it stands:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 25.84; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 25.08; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 25.75; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

We look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
